brand.name: Yuyin
home.title: Text to speech for Hindi, Hinglish, and English.
home.lead: Yuyin streams audio as the text arrives. Numbers, amounts, and mixed-script sentences are spoken the way a person would read them.
placeholder.console.title: Console
placeholder.console.body: The console screens arrive with the component library and mock data.
placeholder.operator.title: Operator
placeholder.operator.body: The operator screens arrive after sign-in and role checks.
auth.signin.title: Sign in
auth.signin.lead: Use the sign-in link your Yuyin operator sent you. Each link works once and expires after 15 minutes.
auth.signin.error: That sign-in link is not valid. Ask your operator for a new one.
auth.signin.noAccount: There is no self-serve sign-up. Organizations and users are created by a Yuyin operator.
